# Implementation Readiness Checklist: WhatsApp Workout Companion

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality checklist for deciding whether the finalized specification and technical design are precise, consistent, testable, and safe enough to generate implementation tasks.
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Workout Domain Invariants

- [x] CHK001 Are the one-active-workout constraints specified consistently across product requirements, state model, database constraints, API rules, and concurrency guidance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024c/FR-024d, Plan §Workout State Machine, Data Model §WorkoutSession/Key Constraints, API §Workout Sessions And Sets]
- [x] CHK002 Are explicit active exercise context changes defined clearly enough to prevent implicit transitions from planned set counts, suggestions, or parser output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035/FR-035a/FR-035b, Plan §Workout State Machine, Data Model §WorkoutSession/SessionExercise]
- [x] CHK003 Is the rule that set logging never auto-advances exercise context represented in requirements, state transitions, quickstart validation, and data-model validation rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-035a/FR-035c, Plan §Workout State Machine, Data Model §SessionExercise, Quickstart §Core Validation Scenario]
- [x] CHK004 Are `IN_PROGRESS` session-exercise lifecycle semantics sufficiently defined so exercises can be left, revisited, skipped, replaced, or completed without conflating lifecycle state with active conversation context? [Clarity, Data Model §SessionExerciseStatus/SessionExercise, Plan §Workout State Machine]
- [x] CHK005 Are completed-session snapshots and routine-edit rules sufficient to ensure completed workout history is never rewritten by future routine changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024/FR-041, Plan §Data And Persistence, Data Model §WorkoutSessionTemplate/WorkoutSession, API §Routines]
- [x] CHK006 Are session-only changes and permanent routine changes distinguished with clear language cues, confirmation policy, and model fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-048/FR-049a-FR-049f, Plan §Structured AI Action Contract/Correction And Confirmation Safety, Data Model §SessionExercise/PendingConfirmation, AI Actions §ChangeScope/RoutineChange]

## Exercise Identity

- [x] CHK007 Are stable exercise identities separated from display names, aliases, global exercises, and user-custom exercises across requirements and data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016/FR-018g, Data Model §ExerciseIdentity/ExerciseAlias]
- [x] CHK008 Are alias confirmation, reuse, conflict handling, and deterministic resolution rules consistent across requirements, model, and AI-action contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018a-FR-018c, Data Model §ExerciseAlias, AI Actions §MAP_EXERCISE_ALIAS]
- [x] CHK009 Are similar-exercise separation and exercise-merge confirmation requirements represented clearly enough to prevent accidental history or PR mixing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017/FR-018d-FR-018f/FR-057b, Data Model §ExerciseIdentity/CorrectionType, API §Exercises And Aliases]
- [x] CHK010 Are custom exercise identities clearly scoped to the owning user while still allowing unknown exercise logging after confirmation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013-FR-016/FR-047, Data Model §ExerciseIdentity, Plan §Hybrid Deterministic And AI Strategy]
- [x] CHK011 Are uncertain, unclassified, and confirmed muscle-classification states defined clearly enough that uncertain classifications cannot silently affect analytics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-064/FR-066a-FR-066d, Data Model §ClassificationStatus/ExerciseMuscleClassification, Plan §Analytics And PR Services]

## Weight And Set Semantics

- [x] CHK012 Are weighted set requirements complete for numeric load, unit, load semantics, reps, notes, failed-attempt context, and safe omissions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029-FR-031, Data Model §WorkoutSet, AI Actions §SetLogInput]
- [x] CHK013 Is per-hand/per-side load preservation specified consistently, including the rule that it is not silently converted into total load? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030c/FR-030d, Data Model §LoadSemantics/WorkoutSet, Plan §Analytics And PR Services]
- [x] CHK014 Is omitted-unit fallback to the user preference bounded by clear safe-context requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030b, Data Model §UserProfile/WorkoutSet, Quickstart §Deterministic Parser Validation]
- [x] CHK015 Are `same` resolution requirements deterministic and explicitly scoped to current active exercise context with comparable prior set data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029/FR-031/FR-035, Plan §Hybrid Deterministic And AI Strategy, AI Actions §Validation Rules]
- [x] CHK016 Are set logging schemas strict enough for required numeric fields while preserving partial correction payloads where the target record supplies existing state? [Consistency, Plan §Hybrid Deterministic And AI Strategy, AI Actions §SetLogInput/CORRECT_SET, Data Model §WorkoutSet/Correction]

## Corrections And Deletions

- [x] CHK017 Are `WorkoutSet` current-state semantics and `Correction` before/after audit semantics specified without requiring accidental set-version chains? [Clarity, Plan §Correction And Confirmation Safety, Data Model §WorkoutSet/Correction]
- [x] CHK018 Are correction idempotency and set uniqueness requirements sufficient to prevent accidental duplicate sets during edits, retries, or multi-set partial processing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037/FR-039g, Plan §Concurrency And Idempotency, Data Model §WorkoutSet/CommandExecution]
- [x] CHK019 Are active-workout quick corrections, cross-exercise corrections, ambiguous corrections, completed-history WhatsApp edits, and web completed-history edits all covered by requirements and design? [Coverage, Spec §FR-036-FR-039g, Plan §Correction And Confirmation Safety, Quickstart §Correction And Destructive Safety Validation]
- [x] CHK020 Are destructive deletion confirmation requirements complete for older sets, exercises, whole workouts, substantial history blocks, export/delete cancellation, and account/data deletion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039e/FR-039f/FR-076, Plan §Correction And Confirmation Safety, Data Model §PendingConfirmation/DataControlRequest]
- [x] CHK021 Are corrected and soft-deleted data semantics clear for analytics, PRs, previous-performance context, and normal history answers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039g, Plan §Analytics And PR Services/Correction And Confirmation Safety, Data Model §WorkoutSet/Derived Query Services]

## Routine Sequence

- [x] CHK022 Is the routine cursor/progression model precise enough for normal sequential completion, missed calendar days, off-sequence workouts, incomplete workouts, discarded workouts, replaced workouts, and explicit permanent sequence changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020/FR-024a/FR-024b/FR-052e/FR-052g, Plan §Routine Sequencing, Data Model §RoutineSequenceCursor/WorkoutSession]
- [x] CHK023 Are sequence advancement rules consistent that only intended sequence-advancing completion changes the normal cursor? [Consistency, Plan §Workout State Machine/Routine Sequencing, Data Model §WorkoutSession/RoutineSequenceCursor]
- [x] CHK024 Is the quickstart validation language aligned with explicit routine sequence progress rather than implying next workout selection from generic sequence history? [Ambiguity, Quickstart §Core Validation Scenario]

## WhatsApp Identity And Messaging

- [x] CHK025 Are provider business account identity and provider-scoped end-user WhatsApp identity clearly separated in model, messaging contract, and security guidance? [Consistency, Plan §WhatsApp Integration/Security, Data Model §WhatsAppProviderAccount/WhatsAppProviderUserIdentity/WhatsAppIdentityLink, Messaging §Interfaces/Deduplication]
- [x] CHK026 Are link ownership rules clear that many product users may communicate through one provider account while one active provider-scoped user identity cannot link to multiple users? [Clarity, Data Model §WhatsAppProviderAccount/WhatsAppIdentityLink, Messaging §Deduplication]
- [x] CHK027 Are webhook authenticity, unlinked identity handling, and provider-message deduplication rules specified before application processing can mutate workout state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Execution Flow/Security, Messaging §Inbound Flow, Quickstart §Webhook Security Validation]
- [x] CHK028 Are WhatsApp identity field names and dedupe scope consistent enough across data-model and messaging/API contracts to avoid implementation ambiguity? [Consistency, Data Model §InboundMessage/WhatsAppProviderUserIdentity, Messaging §InboundMessage/Deduplication, API §Webhook]

## Idempotency And Concurrency

- [x] CHK029 Are duplicate webhook states defined for completed prior processing, in-flight processing, retryable failure, command already applied, outbound already sent, and crash after durable command execution before response? [Completeness, Plan §Concurrency And Idempotency, Data Model §InboundMessage/CommandExecution/OutboundMessage, Messaging §Deduplication]
- [x] CHK030 Are repeated confirmations, stale workout versions, and concurrent same-user messages covered with deterministic idempotency or locking rules? [Coverage, Plan §Concurrency And Idempotency, Data Model §PendingConfirmation/WorkoutSession/CommandExecution, Quickstart §Concurrency And Idempotency Validation]
- [x] CHK031 Are idempotency requirements measurable enough to prove no duplicate sets or duplicate permanent changes under retry and partial-failure scenarios? [Measurability, Plan §Concurrency And Idempotency, Data Model §Key Constraints And Indexes]

- [x] CHK034 Are prompt-injection controls specified for user messages, exercise names, aliases, and other user-provided prompt data? [Coverage, Plan §Security, Research §Treat User Text As Untrusted Prompt Data]
- [x] CHK035 Are deterministic fast-path examples and AI-assisted examples separated clearly enough to avoid unnecessary AI calls? [Clarity, Plan §Hybrid Deterministic And AI Strategy, Quickstart §Deterministic Parser Validation/Ambiguous AI Interpretation Validation, Constitution §II]
